Show the required calculation, classification or matching step clearly.

tableData.title: English evidence table
tableData.question: Use the evidence table to build a literature or writing-skills answer.

activities.questionDesignNote: Questions are original Learnify practice items modelled on CBSE Class XII previous-year and sample-paper patterns: competency-based cases, tables, assertion-reason, source/data interpretation and short analytical answers.
